crop.notes: Notice heads a 'Sporting Notes' column; the clipping holds only the Allen item.

ocr.notes: Matches the print apart from 'sireet' and a stray trailing character.

title.suggested: Tom Allen's Concert Hall on Market Street

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat ran a standing notice under Sporting Notes for Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, offering a free concert every evening with only the best singers.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday, November 14, 1891, page 7. Recurring paid notice; the same text appears in records 828-832.

facts.fact: Allen ran a concert saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, advertising free concerts every evening and billing himself as retired champion pugilist of the world
